visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and bangs, wearing a white floral lace top, stands in a brightly lit white indoor room. She holds a gold YSL cosmetic box, pointing at the label with her right index finger while looking directly at the camera with a smiling expression. (2) She carefully opens the gold outer box to reveal a black inner cardboard sleeve, which she then slides out. The camera focuses on her hands as she extracts a round, pink quilted compact with a prominent gold YSL logo. (3) Close-up of the compact being manipulated by her hands to demonstrate the magnetic closure, creating a distinct physical snap movement. The background remains a soft-focus white studio setting. (4) She opens the compact, revealing a mirror with a protective plastic film which she peels off. The interior displays a vibrant pink blush powder embossed with the YSL logo. She then swatches the powder with her index finger, showing the texture. (5) Using a black makeup brush, she dips into the compact and begins applying the pink blush to her right cheekbone. Her expression is focused, and she occasionally glances at the mirror inside the compact while talking. (6) A side-by-side comparison of her face is shown, highlighting the subtle pink glow on her cheeks. She smiles and gestures towards her face, holding the open compact next to her cheek to showcase the color match. (7) Final shot of the woman holding the closed compact near her face, making a finger heart gesture and smiling warmly at the camera. Yellow and pink graphic text overlays appear around her.
